sessions.intent: Stage 3 of decision 774 — trace every type-family's kind machinery and produce the shape for making each family's kinds kind<T> (no implementation; shape goes to the architect).

before.assumptions: Stage 1 built kind<T> for number; the same shape applies to every family. [Kinds] + the base-class walk + the app-wide kind search + type.format all go; host kinds stay until 673.
before.risk: Conflating the per-type .format filter with the serializer / format-in-play; miscounting which kinds are kind<T> vs named values vs host kinds.

actions.context: Traced the core kind mechanism: kind<T> ctor sets Family via T; FamilyOf/[Kinds] base-walk (item/this.cs:531-532); app-wide search (type/list/this.cs:46-69); type.format filter (type/this.cs:126 + type/format/this.cs) distinct from the serializer and from format-in-play. Per-family map fanned out to an Explore agent.

sessions.actions_note: After the shape was approved (decisions 779/781), implemented the kind<T> migration.

after.status: Stage 3 CORE done + green: every codec/format/path/subclass/list family's kinds are kind<T>; surface re-pinned (774); C# at the 8 baseline fails, plang 254/24/12/3 (zero regressions). 7 OPEN items (bool needs kind for IsClosed; nested-kind read needs a locked-core call; app-wide-search live callers; type.format test surgery; separator+JsonIsItemsKind held on Ingi; template no parent type; kind/strict likely stage-4) — all reported to the architect.
after.health: green at the inherited baseline; no new C# or plang regressions.
after.notes: Commits f4a849b8b..6530916be. Full detail in v3/stage3-result.md. Awaiting rulings on the 7 OPEN items.

sessions.intent: Stage 2 of decision 774 — settings classes become their own top-level types (Internal), not kinds of setting.

before.assumptions: Stage 1 accepted. Each settings class should be its own type named by namespace; base setting stays offered; rows read by key.
before.risk: Persisted settings round-trip depends on the stored type routing to the setting reader; making each class its own type may break disk read-back.

actions.context: Dropped [Kinds] from setting; each class its own type; Rows(context) method (no item Context field); reader reads by key path via Fresh(kind); actor/setting.Class is a path->class index.
Internal => true on ~20 concrete settings subtypes + nested decider.setting ([PlangType]). Base setting stays offered. Representative paths; full set in git diff.
New Internal pin; KindsTests.AClassOfSettings_IsItsOwnType -> app.setting; QueryConversation uses Rows(ctx); surface golden re-pinned (stage-2/settings/kind only).

Persisted read-back fixed via option C (architect decision 779). The setting reader resolves the class from the type it reads as (new rows) or kind-as-path (old rows); per-type instances registered at app boot via the public Reader.Register (internal ctor — no locked-surface change). Surface golden re-pinned (setting.@this.Rows is a context-method per 778, no-Context-field rule). Save unchanged. 5 previously-failing tests green; no new regressions.

after.status: Stage 2 COMPLETE. Settings are their own top-level types (Internal); persisted rows read back by their own type (option C / decision 779). C# gate at the 8 pre-existing baseline fails; plang 254/24/12/3 (improved, SettingClassIsAType pass, no new reds).
after.health: green — all settings C# + plang targets pass; surface golden green (re-pinned under 778/779).
after.notes: Pushed b516eaaf9. Remaining plang /plan/kind-is-type json/separator/file/variable fails are stage 3/4 targets, not stage 2. Awaiting architect acceptance -> stage 3.
